book.name: Ola Saam
book.title: Ola Saam Ola Song En Preya Langa God

content.text: YAWEI, yu na melabat Bos.
Yu brabli haibalawan,
en nobodi jidan haibala laik yu.
Pipul langa ola kantri luk wanim yubin dum,
en brom hebin yu irrim olabat preisimbat yu.
Ola beibi en lilwan biginini sing en preisimbat yu.
Yubin meigim seifwan pleis blanga yuselp dumaji yu garram enami.
Yu garra binijimap ol yu enami olabat,
en detlot pipul hu wandi peiyimbek yu.
Naitaim ai lukap langa det skai weya yubin meigim.
Wen mi luk det mun en detlot sta weya yubin pudum langa olabat rait pleis,
ai jinggabat melabat pipul iya langa graun.
God, pipul nomo enijing.
Wotfo yu oldei jinggabat melabat?
Wotfo yu oldei lukaftumbat melabat?
Yubin meigim melabat ola pipul lobala langa yu,
bat yubin meigim melabat nambawan oni langa yu miselp.
Yubin meigim melabat ola pipul jidan brabli haibala bos
blanga ebrijing weya yubin meigim.
Melabat jidan boswan blanga ola ship en buligi,
en blanga ola kwaitwan enimul en blanga ola enimul langa bush.
Melabat jidan boswan blanga ola bard langa skai en ola fish langa solwoda,
en blanga ebrijing weya jidan laibala insaid langa solwoda.
YAWEI, yu na melabat bos.
Yu brabli haibala,
en nobodi jidan haibala laik yu.
Pipul langa ola kantri luk wanim yubin dum.
